title: Opportunities
text: Which opportunity should we solve first, and why? What unmet needs emerge consistently across conversations? Ranked SIP problems and opportunity scores.
about: My SIP instalment or autopay failed, money was debited but the SIP was not processed, I cannot pause or change my SIP amount, the returns are confusing, losses worry me.

title: Why people start and what they expect
text: Why do people start a SIP, and what do they expect to happen? Goals, motivation and expectations.
about: I started a SIP for long-term wealth, retirement, a goal, a saving habit or tax saving, and I expect it to grow steadily over the years.

title: What changes after starting
text: What changes in investor behaviour in the months after starting a SIP? Onboarding, first instalment, months 2 to 6, months 7 to 12, after the first year.
about: I just set up my SIP mandate; my first instalment went through; a few months into my SIP; I have been doing SIPs for years.

title: What investors check and how often
text: What do investors check, and how often, once they have started a SIP? Checking frequency.
about: I check my SIP portfolio every day, every week, once a month on the debit day, or rarely.

title: In-app confusion
text: What confuses or worries investors inside the app? Returns, payment status, NAV, units, SIP dates.
about: I don't understand the returns or P&L shown in the app, whether my instalment went through, which NAV I got or how many units were allotted.

title: Outside the app
text: What do investors do outside the app when they feel unsure? Where do they go for help: forums, support, YouTube, friends, advisors.
about: I asked on a forum or Reddit, contacted customer support, checked the AMC website, watched YouTube, or asked friends, family or an advisor.

title: Failure modes
text: What leads investors to pause, reduce or stop a SIP? Which problems make SIPs fail: failed instalments, autopay and mandate failures, money debited twice, cannot pause or change the amount, confusing returns.
about: My SIP instalment failed, the autopay mandate was rejected, money was debited twice, I could not pause or modify my SIP.

title: Triggers
text: Market or not: do market falls and losses make investors stop their SIPs, or other triggers such as switching platform, charges, a cash-flow shock or app bugs?
about: I stopped my SIP because the market fell and I saw losses, I switched to another platform or a direct plan, the charges, or I lost my job.

title: Continuers vs drop-offs
text: What separates investors who continue from those who quietly drop off?
about: I kept my SIP going despite the problems, while others stopped, paused or are thinking of stopping their SIP.

title: Patterns by segment
text: How do patterns differ across user segments: income stability, age, source of money, who influenced them, residency, NRI, students, salaried?
about: I am a student, salaried, self-employed, an NRI, in my twenties; I started after watching YouTube or on a friend's advice.

title: First-time investors
text: What is specific to first-time investors? How do first-time investors differ from experienced ones?
about: I am a first-time investor, new to mutual funds, I just started my first SIP; I have been investing for many years.

title: How quality was checked
text: How was the quality of the insights validated? Where did the engine fail?

title: How it was built
text: How was the engine built? How does it gather and analyse data, identify themes and generate insights?
